verifications.title: Per-process authority verification
verifications.criterion: On every supported OS/version, each process can perform every allowed operation and no denied probe; inherited descriptors and effective privileges exactly match the reviewed manifest.

verifications.title: Root containment campaign
verifications.criterion: No invalid component, race, link, identity change, or unauthorized mount causes any filesystem access outside the conferred root or any archive mutation.

verifications.title: Authenticated session and downgrade verification
verifications.criterion: Only mutually authenticated, archive-authorized, transcript-bound sessions become active; all replay, cross-context, non-canonical, unknown-critical, and downgrade cases fail before product mutation.

verifications.title: Journal corruption and truncation campaign
verifications.criterion: The reader accepts exactly the longest complete valid prefix, reports a torn tail, and rejects every interior alteration, sequence gap, fork, non-canonical record, or limit violation.

verifications.title: Authorization and transaction invariant verification
verifications.criterion: Publication is unreachable without exact authorization bindings, and mutation of any bound field or illegal state transition prevents publication without archive side effects.

verifications.title: Destructive-operation safety verification
verifications.criterion: Every missing precondition, threshold crossing, overflow, unknown value, capacity failure, or identity mismatch stops before mutation; every completed removal remains restorable for retention.

verifications.title: Filesystem semantic compatibility matrix
verifications.criterion: Every declared semantic has exactly one evidenced classification for each supported profile; unrepresentable and unknown cases are refused without target mutation.

verifications.title: Planner determinism verification
verifications.criterion: All permutations and schedules of identical canonical inputs produce byte-identical plan output and digest.

verifications.title: Configuration grammar and immutability verification
verifications.criterion: Invalid or ambiguous configuration is rejected before authority acquisition; canonical equivalent inputs have one digest; active session policy never changes on reload.

verifications.title: Resource exhaustion verification
verifications.criterion: No external value allocates or admits work before limit validation; exhaustion produces bounded cleanup, truthful status, and preserves recovery evidence.

verifications.title: Persistence-point crash recovery campaign
methods: kill before and after each persistence operation
verifications.criterion: Every injected interruption preserves authorization and valid-prefix invariants; recovery never duplicates publication/confirmation and a second recovery has no additional effect.

verifications.title: Independent release reconstruction and verification
verifications.criterion: An independent builder reproduces every specified artifact bit for bit and a disconnected verifier validates digests, signatures, SBOM, provenance, and authorized source without a public service.

verifications.title: Assurance record referential integrity
verifications.criterion: The validator reports no duplicate, malformed, orphan, missing, or asymmetric reference and generated traceability is byte-current.
